msContents.summary: This copy of the Itihāsasamuccaya was digitized by eGangotri as part of the Mumukshu Bhawan Varanasi Collection and uploaded to the Internet Archive in 2022. This is the editio princeps, published in 1915/1916 (śaka 1838, saṃvat 1973), although an earlier Greek translation by Demetrios Galanos was published in 1851.

lg.l: tasmāt tvam api rājeṃdra dehi nyāyārjitaṃ dhanam ||

dānā
j jñānaṃ ca tat prāpya jñānāt_ siddhiṃ ca yāsyasi || 60 ||
kathayaṃtaṃ hitārthānāṃ prabhāvānadbhutāṃs tathā ||
romaśaṃ dharmatatvajñaṃ paryyapṛcchad yudhiṣṭhiraḥ || 1 ||

yo
rakṣet prāṇinaṃ rājā bhayāttaṃ śaraṇāgatam ||

tasya puṇyaphalaṃ yat syāt tan me
brūhi tapodhana || 2 ||

ekataḥ kratavaḥ sarve samāptavarada
kṣiṇāḥ ||
ekato bhayabhītasya prāṇinaḥ prāṇarakṣaṇam || 3 ||

etad eva purā
devā tulayā samatolayan ||
prāṇarakṣaṇam eveha gauraveṇātiricyate || 4 ||
atraivodāharaṃtīmam itihāsaṃ purātanam ||

iṃdrasyāgneś ca saṃvādaṃ śiber auśī
narasya ca || 5 ||
varttamāne mahāyajñe jijñāsārthaṃ śibiṃ nṛpam ||

iṃdraḥ śyenaḥ
kapoto 'gnir bhūtvā tatropajagmatuḥ || 6 ||

atha taṃ nṛpatiṃ prāpya
kapotaḥ śyenato bhayāt ||

śaraṇārthī mahīpālaṃ nililye bhayavihvalaḥ
|| 7 ||
tataḥ śanair upāgamya śyenarūpī sureśvaraḥ ||

rājānaṃ sumahā
tmānaṃ provācedaṃ vacas tadā || 8 ||

dharmātmānaṃ bhuvi
prāhur ekaṃ tvādyamahīkṣitam ||

tvaṃ vai śaraṇadānena rakṣa māṃ pīḍitaṃ kṣudhā
|| 9 ||
dharmabudhyā tvayā dharmaḥ kriyate sūkṣmabuddhinā ||

sa tvaṃ dharma
viśuddhena kathaṃ dharmaṃ cikīrṣasi || 10 ||

bhavān_ kṛtaghnaṃ dānena satyenā
nṛtavādinam ||
kṣamayā krūrakarmāṇam asādhuṃ sādhunā jayet || 11 ||
ko 'yaṃ dharmas tavedānīm ahaṃ vismayam īyivān ||

asādhuḥ pālyate rājan
sādhur vai pālyate tvayā || 12 ||
nāpakārāpareṣv evam upakāraparo janaḥ ||
apakārapare 'pi tvam upakaraparo janaḥ || 13 ||

ahite hitabuddhis tvaṃ
pāpeṣu tvam apāpakṛt ||
doṣānveṣaṇadakṣo 'pi guṇānveṣaṇatatparaḥ || 14 ||
tad eṣa vihito bhakṣaḥ pīḍyamānasya me kṣudhā ||

mā hiṃsīr lobhato dharmaṃ
dharmam utsṛṣṭavānasi || 15 ||

saṃtrastarūpī trāṇārthī tvatto
bhīto vihaṃgamaḥ ||
matsakāśam anuprāptaḥ pālyo 'gaghrugayaṃajānato 'pīndraṃ tadbhāraty evaṃ jagāda | khagaḥ || 16 ||
tad evam āgatasyāsya kapotasya mayārthinaḥ ||

katham asmadvidhaḥ kuryā
t tyāgaṃ sadbhir vigarhitam || 17 ||

lobhād veṣād bhayād vāpi yastyajecchara
ṇāgatam ||
brahmahatyāsamaṃ tasya pāpam āhur manīṣiṇaḥ || 18 ||

śāstreṣu
niṣkṛtir dṛṣṭā mahāpātakinām api ||

śaraṇāgatahaṃtus tu na dṛṣṭā niṣkṛtiḥ
kvacit || 19 ||
yathātmanaḥ priyāḥ prāṇāḥ sarveṣāṃ prāṇināṃ tathā ||
tasmān mṛtyubhayatrastās trātavyāḥ prāṇino budhaiḥ || 20 ||

janma
mṛtyujarāduḥkhair nityaṃ saṃsārasāgare ||

jaṃtavaḥ parikliśyaṃte mṛtyos trasyaṃ
ti te tathā || 21 ||
yannimittaṃ bhaved doṣas trāso vā krodha eva vā ||
āyāso vā yathā duṣṭam ekāṃtam api na tyajet || 22 ||

mariṣyā
mīti yad duḥkhaṃ puruṣasyopajāyate ||

jñeyas tenānumānena paro 'pi pari
rakṣitum || 23 ||

yathā ca te jīvitam ātmanaḥ priyaṃ tathā pare
ṣām api jīvitaṃ priyam ||

saṃrakṣase jīvitam ātmano yathā tathā pare
ṣām api rakṣa jīvitam || 24 ||

tasmān nāham imaṃ dīnam arpayiṣye kapo
takam ||
yad atra yuktam anyaṃ te vaktuṃ śyenāśu tad vada || 25 ||
prāyaśaḥ puruṣā loke sarvabhūtadayāparāḥ ||

gacchaṃti brahmasadanam iti
prāhur manīṣiṇaḥ || 26 ||

mahatām api yajñānāṃ kālena kṣīyate
phalam ||
bhītābhayapradānasya kalāṃ nārhati ṣoḍaśīm || 27 ||
catuḥsāgaraparyaṃtāṃ yo dadyāt pṛthivīm imām ||

abhayaṃ sarvabhūtebhyas tayo
r abhayado 'dhikaḥ || 28 ||

api tyaje rājyam idaṃ śarīraṃ ca sudustya
jam ||
nāgataṃ bhayasaṃtrastaṃ tyakṣye dīnaṃ kapotakam || 29 ||

yan me
syāt tu śubhaṃ kiṃcid arjitaṃ pūrvajanmani ||

tenādya vai bhayārttānām ā
rtināśāya dehinām || 30 ||
na hy ahaṃ kāmaye rājyaṃ na svargaṃ nāpunarbhavam ||
prāṇināṃ duḥkhataptānāṃ kāmaye duḥkhanāśanam || 31 ||

yathā ca
nānṛtā vāṇī mayā vai samudāhṛtā ||

satyenānena bhagavān_ prasīdatu mahe
śvaraḥ || 32 ||
āhārārthaṃ samāraṃbhas tava cāyaṃ vihaṃgamaḥ ||

yo ya iṣṭa
s tavāhāro hy anyaṃ vada dadāmy aham || 33 ||

evaṃ hi
vihito 'smākaṃ dhātrā bhakṣaṃ kapotakaḥ ||

tam evotsṛjya nāhāraiḥ kāryam a
nyair nareśvara || 34 ||
āhārāt sarvabhūtāni saṃbhavaṃti nareśvara ||

āhā
reṇa vivardhaṃte tena jīvaṃti jaṃtavaḥ || 35 ||

śakyate duṣkare 'py arthe ciraṃ
rātreṇa jīvitum ||
na tv āhāravihīnena śakyaṃ varttayituṃ cirāt || 36 ||
bhakṣyād vilopitasyādya mama prāṇā viśāṃpate ||

visṛjya kāyaṃ yāsyaṃti
paṃthānam apunarbhavam || 37 ||
mṛte ca mayi sarvaṃ me putradāraṃ mariṣyati ||
rakṣaṇena kapotasya bahūn prāṇān na rakṣasi || 38 ||

yo dharmaṃ bādhate dharmo
na sa dharmaḥ paraṃtapa ||
avirodhī tu yo dharmaḥ sa dharmaḥ sadbhir ucyate || 39 ||
tasmād virodhidharmasya viciṃtya gurulāghavam ||

yato bhūyāṃs tato rājan ku
ru dharmavinirṇayam || 40 ||

nāsti satyāt paro dharmaḥ
kaścid anyo hi khecaraḥ ||

prāṇināṃ bhayabhītānām abhayaṃ yaḥ prayacchati
|| 41 ||
varam etasya satvasya pradattābhayadakṣiṇā ||

na ca vāji
sahasrasya gosahasram alaṃkṛtam || 42 ||

abhayaṃ sarvabhūtebhyo yo dadāti
dayāparaḥ ||
tasya dehād vimuktasya kṣaya eva na vidyate || 43 ||
hemadhenudharādīnāṃ dātāraḥ sulabhā bhuvi ||

durllabhaḥ puruṣo loke sarva
bhūtadayāparaḥ || 44 ||

śyenāḥ kapotān khādaṃti
śrutir eṣā sanātanī ||
mā rājan_ sāram ajñātvā kadalīstaṃbham āruha ||
pīyūṣabuddhim āsthāya viṣam aśnāsi kevalam || 45 ||

nāhaṃ
kuśāstramārgeṇa kvacid vartte vihaṃgama ||

śāstre caivopadiṣṭo 'yaṃ dharmaḥ satvada
yāparaḥ || 46 ||
sarvasatveṣu yad dānam ekasatve ca yā dayā ||

sarvasatvapradā
nāt tu dayaikā ca viśiṣyate || 47 ||

sarve vedā na tat kuryuḥ sarve yajñāś ca
khecara ||
sarvatīrthābhiṣeko yo yaḥ kuryān prāṇināṃ dayām || 48 ||

vā
ṅ_manaḥkarmabhir ye tu sarvabhūtahite ratāḥ ||

dayādamitapāpmāno brahma
lokaṃ vrajaṃti te || 49 ||

gacchatas tiṣṭhato vāpi jāgrataḥ svapato 'pi
vā ||
yan na bhūtahitārthāya tat paśor iva jīvitam || 50 ||
jaṃgamāni ca bhūtāni sthāvarāṇi ca ye narāḥ ||

ātmavatparira
kṣaṃti te yāṃti paramāṃ gatim || 51 ||

prāṇanāṃ vadhyamānānāṃ yaḥ
kaścit samupekṣate ||
sa yāti narakaṃ ghoram iti prāhur manīṣiṇaḥ || 52 ||
rājyaṃ hi sakalaṃ caitat prayacchāmi tava dvija ||

yadi kāmayase hy anyaṃ varja
yitvā kapotakam || 53 ||

yadi rājan kapote te sudṛḍhā
bhaktir īdṛśī ||
tattvaṃ kapotatulyāni svamāṃsāni prayaccha me || 54 ||
anugraham imaṃ manye yan māṃ iyenābhibhāṣase ||

etat te 'haṃ
prayacchāmi svamāṃsaṃ yāvad icchasi || 55 ||

yad apriyaṃ tat svajanaḥ kaści
d vadati vā na vā ||
mama tu priyam evaitat kasmād abhihitaṃ cirāt || 56 ||
adhruveṇa śarīreṇa pratikṣaṇavināśinā ||

dhruvaṃ yo nārjeyed dharmaṃ sa śocyo
mūḍhacetanaḥ || 57 ||
yadi prāṇyupakārāya deho 'yaṃ nopayujyate ||

tataḥ
kim upacārāḥ syuḥ pratyakṣaṃ kriyate tathā || 58 ||

nāti
riktam ahaṃ yāce tava māṃsaṃ nareśvara ||

yenāsya rakṣaṇaṃ me syāt tadvidhatsva
narottama || 59 ||

evam uktaḥ svamāṃsāni tam utkṛtya ca
pārthivaḥ ||
prahṛṣṭas tolayāmāsa kapotena saha prabhuḥ || 60 ||

tyaktvātma
sukhabhogecchā sarvasattvasukhaiṣiṇaḥ ||

bhavaṃti paraduḥkheṣu sādhavo nitya
duḥkhitāḥ || 61 ||
dhriyamāṇaṃ tu tulyā kapotena samaṃ sadā ||
utkṛtya palalaṃ tasmāt kapotas tv adhiko 'bhavat ||

tataḥ prakṣīṇamāṃso
sāv āruroha tulāṃ svayam || 62 ||

paraduḥkhāturā nityaṃ sarvabhūtahite
ratāḥ ||
nopekṣaṃte mahānmānaḥ svasukhāni mahāṃty api || 63 ||

atha
tasmin samārūḍhe tulām auśīnare nṛpe ||

devaduṃdubhayo neduḥ puṣpavṛṣṭiḥ
papāta ha || 64 ||
tatas tasya tadā matvā devarājo dhṛtiṃ parām ||
śākraḥ svaṃ rūpam āsthāya vākyam etad abhāṣata || 65 ||
indro 'ham asmi bhadraṃ te kapoto havyavāhanaḥ ||

jijñāsamānau tvāṃ rāja
nn imaṃ yajñam upāgatau || 66 ||
naitat pūrve nṛpāś cakrur na kariṣyaṃti cāpare ||
mahākāruṇikeneha yat kṛtaṃ duṣkṛtaṃ tvayā || 67 ||

parārthe tyajataḥ
prāṇānyā prītir abhavat tava ||

prāṇasaṃśayalubdheṣu na sā prāyo 'sti
dehiṣu || 68 ||
parārthaikāṃtakalyāṇī svāśrayātyaṃtaniṣṭhurā ||

tvayy eva
kevalaṃ rājan karuṇā karuṇāyate || 69 ||

svakarmapāśaiḥ sudṛḍhair baddhaṃ
kṛtsnam idaṃ jagat ||
tvaṃ jagadduḥkhamokṣārthaṃ baddhaḥ karuṇāyā nṛpa || 70 ||
yathā sarvātmanā vāpi duḥkheṣu prahitaṃ manaḥ ||

tathā caivātmasaṃkhyāne
vāsanāpi na śoṣitā || 71 ||

prakṛterṣyāṃ viśuddheṣu na hīnānavamanya
ca ||
agatvā sadṛśaiḥ sparddhāṃ tvaṃ lokottaratāṃ gataḥ || 72 ||

paropa
kārajanmāno vidhātrā vihitās trayaḥ ||

sajalā jaladās tvaṃ ca saphalāś ca
mahādrumāḥ || 73 ||
ātmaprāṇaiḥ paraprāṇānyo naraḥ parirakṣati ||

saḥ
yāti tatparaṃ sthānaṃ yato nāvartate punaḥ || 74 ||

prāṇair api tvayā
rājan rakṣitaḥ kṛpaṇo janaḥ ||

svamāṃsāny api dattāni dravyeṣv anyeṣu kā
kathā || 75 ||
paśavo 'pi hi jīvaṃti kevalātmodaraṃbharāḥ ||

sa punar jī
vaṃti ślāghyo yaḥ parārthe hi jīvati || 76 ||

kim atra citraṃ yat saṃtaḥ parā
nugrahatatparāḥ ||
na hi svadehaśītāya jāyaṃte candanadrumāḥ || 77 ||

paro
pakāravyāpāraparo yaḥ puruṣaḥ sadā ||

sa padaṃ tad avāpnoti parād api hi
yat param || 78 ||
paropakāraikadhiyaḥ svasukhāya gataspṛhāḥ ||

jagaddhi
tāya jāyaṃte sādhavas tv ādṛśā bhuvi || 79 ||

yat te māṃsāni gātrebhyaḥ
samutkṛttāni pārthiva ||
eṣā te śāśvatī kīrtir lokān anugāmiṣyati || 80 ||
divyarūpadharaś caiva pālayitvā ca medinīm ||

sarvān_ lokān atikramya
brahmalokaṃ gamiṣyasi || 81 ||

evam uktvā tam iṃdrāgnī
jagmatus tridaśālayam ||
rājāpi kratum iṣṭvā hi sumude devavac ciram || 82 ||
ya idaṃ śṛṇuyān nityaṃ śibeś caritam uttamam ||

sa vidhūyeha pāpāni prayāti
tridivaṃ naraḥ || 83 ||

viciṃtya rājā svaśarīram adhruvaṃ yaśaś ca sarvasya
janasya durlabham ||

śarīradānāt parirakṣaṇaṃ tathā vidhāya lokatrayabhū
ṣaṇaṃ yayau || 84 ||
